newsitem.title: USA: FOMC begins meeting on interest rates.
newsitem.headline: FOMC begins meeting on interest rates.

text.p: Policysetting members of the Federal Open Market Committee began meeting at 9 a.m. (1300 GMT) Tuesday, a Fed spokesman said.
The FOMC will consider whether more interest-rate rises are needed as insurance against inflation.

Despite signs the economy slowed in the second quarter, private economists were split on whether it has lost enough steam to ward off inflation risks on its own. A slim majority of bond dealers surveyed by Reuters expected no change in rates this time.
The Fed raised the federal funds rate a quarter percentage point at its last meeting on March 25. A decision from today's meeting is expected at about 2:15 p.m. (1815 GMT).
